body.text: “Brian, I’ll tell you about a man I’ll never forget. My friend, Mark, was working at a fire station near the World Trade Center. A buddy of his was scheduled to work on September 11, 2001, but his wife had to go to the hospital to give birth to their baby. So Mark took his shift. Do you know what happened that day?” “The September 11 attacks,” I answered. “Mark was one of the first to run into the World Trade Center,” Dad paused. “Some people running out of the building said, ‘There’s a fireman up there. He got us out of here. Help him!’ But, it was too late. He never came out.” He was silent for a moment. “Listen, Brian. Mark was a real hero. It was I that changed my schedule, and you were the baby who was born that day. We are here thanks to him.”
